```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'  # Every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  detect-abuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        
      - name: Run abuse detection
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts \
            --last 24h \
            --parallel 3 \
            --auto-apply
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          POLLINATIONS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.POLLINATIONS_API_KEY }}
          
      - name: Run abuse blocks application
        if: success() || failure()
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/apply-abuse-blocks.ts
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          POLLINATIONS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.POLLINATIONS_API_KEY }}
```
